nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address; set from msg.sender in constructor and writable via setOwner, gates onlyOwner-protected fund functions.
CappedVault.limit: hard cap used by the payable fallback to restrict total deposits.
CappedVault.withdrawn: running total of withdrawn funds, updated with unchecked addition.
Pausable.paused: circuit breaker flag consumed by PresalePackThree.purchase (via whenNotPaused) and claimPheonix.
Governable.governor: privileged address controlling protocol-management functions.
CardBase.cards: on-chain array of minted Card structs.
CardProto.limits: mapping(uint16 => Limit) issuing caps for mythic cards.
CardProto.seasonTradable: per-season tradability switch, also used as immutability guard in replaceProto.
CardProto.seasonTradabilityLocked: irreversible lock flag for a season's tradability.
CardProto.currentSeason: season counter incremented in nextSeason without overflow protection.
CardProto.protos: mapping(uint16 => ProtoCard) of card prototypes.
CardProto.protoCount: number of prototypes added, incremented in _addProto.
CardProto.mythic: array of packable mythic proto ids (cleared in nextSeason, read by getRandomCard).
CardProto.legendary: array of packable legendary proto ids.
CardProto.epic: array of packable epic proto ids.
CardProto.rare: array of packable rare proto ids.
CardProto.common: array of packable common proto ids.
CardPackThree.migration: external MigrationInterface used to mint cards; untrusted callee.
CardPackThree.creationBlock: reference block number for the pricing schedule.
FirstPheonix.approved: append-only list of addresses allowed to trigger claimPheonix.
FirstPheonix.claimed: per-user flag preventing repeated phenoix claims.
PresalePackThree.vault: CappedVault instance that receives purchase proceeds.
PresalePackThree.purchases: array of Purchase records holding randomness and per-pack progress.
PresalePackThree.canClaim: owner-controlled gate for the claim path.
PackMultiplier.packs: whitelist of prior pack addresses accepted by claimMultiple.
PackMultiplier.multiplier: uint16 factor applied to migrated pack counts.
PackMultiplier.packLimit: threshold deciding whether legacy migration loop runs.
PackMultiplier.pheonix: FirstPheonix contract invoked during multiple claims.
PackMultiplier.old: PreviousInterface legacy contract queried for supply/burn/owner data.
constructor(): assigns owner = msg.sender.
setOwner(address _owner) onlyOwner: transfers ownership to an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner modifier: access-control check msg.sender == owner.
Vault fallback(): payable, accepts arbitrary ether without accounting.
getBalance(): returns address(this).balance.
Vault.withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner: balance check then owner.transfer(amount).
Vault.withdrawAll() onlyOwner: forwards full contract balance to withdraw.
constructor(): sets limit = 33333 ether.
CappedVault fallback(): payable, requires total() + msg.value <= limit.
total(): getBalance() + withdrawn.
CappedVault.withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner: transfers then increments withdrawn (state after external call).
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused: sets paused = true.
unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused: sets paused = false.
constructor(): governor = msg.sender.
setGovernor(address _gov) onlyGovernor: transfers governor rights.
pause() onlyGovernor whenNotPaused: sets the Governable paused flag.
unpause() onlyGovernor whenPaused: clears the Governable paused flag.
onlyGovernor modifier: access-control check msg.sender == governor.
setLimit(uint16,uint64) onlyGovernor: write-once mythic limit registration.
makeUntradable(uint8) onlyGovernor: disables tradability unless locked.
makePermanantlyTradable(uint8) onlyGovernor: locks a season as tradable.
nextSeason() onlyGovernor: increments currentSeason and resets rarity arrays.
addProtos(...) onlyGovernor: batch proto addition loop.
_addProto(...) internal: stores proto, increments protoCount, pushes into rarity arrays.
getRandomCard(uint16 random) view: indexes rarity arrays with caller-supplied randomness.
replaceProto(...) onlyGovernor: overwrites proto for non-tradable seasons.
constructor(MigrationInterface _core): stores core migration contract.
approvePack(address) onlyOwner: appends to approved list.
claimPheonix(address user): approved-caller claim that mints via core.createCard.
CardPackThree constructor: sets migration and creationBlock.
PresalePackThree constructor: sets vault.
purchase(uint16 packCount, address referrer) whenNotPaused payable: records Purchase, pays referrer commission, forwards funds to vault.
callback(uint id): permissionless randomness derivation from blockhash and commit block.
claim(uint id): mints cards through migration.createCard in a nested loop and advances p.current.
predictPacks(uint id) view: recomputes pack contents off-chain.
calculatePrice(uint base, uint16 packCount) view: time-based discount arithmetic on block.number.
getComponents(...) internal: keccak-based randomness decomposition.
extract(uint,uint,uint) internal pure: bit slicing helper, shift size derived from inputs.
setCanClaim(bool) onlyOwner: toggles the claim gate.
withdraw() onlyOwner: sends entire balance to owner.
PackMultiplier constructor: stores packs, pheonix, old references.
getCardCount() internal view: old.totalSupply() + old.burnCount().
claimMultiple(address pack, uint purchaseID): calls an arbitrary whitelisted pack, derives extra packs, calls pheonix and migration.migrate.
setPackLimit(uint16) onlyOwner: updates migration branch threshold.
basePrice(): returns 12 finney.
getCardDetails(...) view: maps randomness to rarity/purity and calls migration.getRandomCard.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for authentication, ownership, purchase attribution and referral checks.
owner.transfer(amount): external value transfer to a stored address.
owner.transfer(amount) before accounting update: external call preceding state write.
withdrawn += amount: unchecked addition on withdrawal accounting.
referrer.transfer(commission): value sent to a caller-supplied address, reentrancy surface.
address(vault).transfer(price): forwards purchase funds to the vault contract.
owner.transfer(address(this).balance): drains the whole contract balance.
currentSeason++: unchecked increment (require(currentSeason <= 255) is ineffective for uint8).
protoCount++: unchecked uint16 increment.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(p.commit), p.user, address(this), p.count)): miner/validator-influenceable randomness.
discount arithmetic (base - ((20 - numDays) * base) / 100) * packCount: unchecked integer math.
migration.createCard(user, proto, purity) called in a loop: external call to an untrusted migration contract.
p.current += (end - current): purchase progress updated after external calls.
core.createCard(user, PHEONIX_PROTO, 0): external mint call on an untrusted migration interface.
PresalePackThree(pack).claim(purchaseID): external call into a caller-supplied (whitelisted) pack contract.
old.totalSupply()/burnCount()/ownerOf(): external view calls on the legacy contract, used to size mints.
pheonix.claimPheonix(lastCardOwner): external mint call during multiple-claim flow.
migration.migrate(...) in a loop bounded by cardDifference: external call per migrated card.
extra = packCount * multiplier: uint16 multiplication that can overflow and wrap.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(i, rand, j)): deterministic pseudo-randomness derived from callback result.
migration.getRandomCard(rarity, protoRandom): external call into the migration contract during view computation.
amount parameter of Vault.withdraw, controls the transferred value.
_owner parameter of setOwner, becomes the new owner.
amount parameter of CappedVault.withdraw.
id parameter of callback, indexes the purchases array without bound checks.
id parameter of claim, indexes the purchases array without bound checks.
packCount parameter of purchase, drives price and Purchase.count.
referrer parameter of purchase, receives a 10% commission transfer.
pack parameter of claimMultiple, an address cast to PresalePackThree and called.
purchaseID parameter of claimMultiple, forwarded to the external pack claim call.
user parameter of claimPheonix, arbitrary address receiving the minted card.
Purchase storage pointer used in callback.
random local derived from the blockhash-based keccak value in callback.
bhash local holding blockhash(p.commit) in callback.
price local computed by calculatePrice and used for transfers in purchase.
Purchase storage pointer used in claim.
result local reading p.randomness in claim, gates card generation.
count local reading p.count in claim.
cardDifference local computed from external supply deltas and cast to uint16.
lengthAfter local holding the post-claim card count.
extra local holding packCount * multiplier result.
Governable.paused: separate paused flag maintained by Governable.pause/unpause.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner; the check is the sole access barrier.
owner state variable is read inside the onlyOwner check.
onlyOwner guards setOwner; bypass or mis-set owner grants full control.
_owner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
setOwner overwrites owner with a caller-supplied address, transferring all owner privileges.
onlyOwner guards Pausable.pause.
onlyOwner guards Pausable.unpause.
pause sets paused = true, a privileged state transition.
unpause sets paused = false.
claimPheonix reads paused and returns early, so pause state gates minting.
Governable.pause sets its own paused flag.
Governable.unpause clears its own paused flag.
amount parameter controls the value transferred by Vault.withdraw.
Vault.withdraw performs owner.transfer(amount), an external value transfer.
withdrawAll forwards address(this).balance into withdraw.
CappedVault constructor initialises limit.
payable fallback enforces total() + msg.value <= limit using the limit state variable.
fallback calls total() to evaluate the cap.
amount parameter controls the value transferred by CappedVault.withdraw.
CappedVault.withdraw performs owner.transfer(amount).
external transfer executes before withdrawn += amount, so re-entrancy can double-count withdrawals.
withdrawn is increased with an unchecked addition.
total() returns getBalance() + withdrawn.
onlyGovernor guards setGovernor.
onlyGovernor compares msg.sender with governor.
governor state variable is read by the onlyGovernor check.
setGovernor overwrites governor, transferring all governor privileges.
onlyOwner guards approvePack.
approvePack appends an address to the approved list, granting mint rights.
claimPheonix sets claimed[user] = true.
claimPheonix requires isApproved(msg.sender); any approved caller can mint to an arbitrary user.
approved list is scanned to authorise msg.sender.
claimed[user] flag prevents repeated minting for the same user.
external call core.createCard on an untrusted MigrationInterface address.
user parameter is passed to core.createCard without any relation to msg.sender.
onlyGovernor guards setLimit.
setLimit writes the limits mapping for mythic cards.
onlyGovernor guards makeUntradable.
makeUntradable writes seasonTradable[season] = false.
onlyGovernor guards makePermanantlyTradable.
makePermanantlyTradable sets the irreversible lock flag.
onlyGovernor guards nextSeason.
nextSeason executes currentSeason++ with no effective overflow protection.
unchecked increment writes the currentSeason state variable (uint8 wraparound).
nextSeason clears the rarity id arrays including mythic.
onlyGovernor guards addProtos.
addProtos loops over caller arrays and calls _addProto.
_addProto increments protoCount without bounds or overflow checks.
protoCount++ writes the protoCount state variable.
_addProto writes the protos mapping entry.
_addProto pushes new ids into the rarity arrays.
onlyGovernor guards replaceProto.
replaceProto overwrites an existing protos entry.
replaceProto requires the proto season to be non-tradable, using seasonTradable as an immutability guard.
getRandomCard indexes the rarity arrays with caller-supplied randomness (modulo bias).
getRandomCard reads mythic limits to respect issuance caps.
packCount parameter drives pricing and the stored Purchase count.
referrer parameter receives a commission transfer.
purchase attributes msg.sender as buyer and only rejects referrer == msg.sender.
purchase pushes a Purchase record into the purchases array.
price local is computed by calculatePrice(basePrice(), packCount).
calculatePrice performs unchecked integer arithmetic on the discount schedule.
calculatePrice derives numDays from block.number - creationBlock.
referrer.transfer sends value to an arbitrary address before the vault transfer, a reentrancy surface.
address(vault).transfer(price) forwards the purchase proceeds.
callback id parameter selects the Purchase entry without bounds checking.
callback derives its randomness from blockhash and stored purchase data.
derived randomness is written back into the Purchase record in purchases.
bhash local stores blockhash(p.commit).
bhash feeds the keccak256 randomness expression.
keccak output is assigned to the random local.
storage pointer to the selected Purchase is created in callback.
claim id parameter indexes purchases without bounds checking.
claim obtains a storage pointer to the Purchase entry.
result local reads p.randomness and gates card generation.
count local reads p.count for the loop bounds.
claim requires the owner-controlled canClaim flag.
claim calls migration.createCard repeatedly; a malicious migration contract can re-enter before p.current is advanced.
claim performs p.current += (end - current) after the external calls.
purchase progress is written back after external interaction, enabling repeated claiming on re-entry.
onlyOwner guards setCanClaim.
setCanClaim writes the canClaim state variable.
onlyOwner guards PresalePackThree.withdraw.
withdraw transfers the contract balance to owner.
pack address parameter is validated against the packs whitelist then cast and called.
purchaseID parameter is forwarded to the external pack claim call.
an external pack contract is invoked; state changes are derived from external supply deltas.
legacy totals and ownerOf are queried on the PreviousInterface contract.
pheonix.claimPheonix is invoked during multiple-claim processing.
claimMultiple computes extra = packCount * multiplier with uint16 arithmetic.
overflow-prone multiplication result is stored in the extra local and used as a pack count.
migration.migrate is called in a loop bounded by cardDifference.
claimMultiple pushes a derived Purchase record.
cardDifference local is computed from external supply deltas and cast to uint16.
lengthAfter local holds the post-claim card count.
onlyOwner guards setPackLimit.
setPackLimit writes the packLimit state variable used by the migration branch.
getCardDetails calls migration.getRandomCard, an external dependency for rarity selection.
getCardDetails calls getComponents, which derives pseudo-randomness with keccak256.
getComponents executes the keccak256 randomness expression.
PresalePackThree constructor stores the vault address that receives all purchase funds.
PackMultiplier constructor stores the packs whitelist used by claimMultiple.
constructor stores the pheonix contract reference.
constructor stores the legacy PreviousInterface reference.
CardPackThree constructor stores the migration contract address.
CardPackThree constructor sets creationBlock for the pricing schedule.
